thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: routing-service error-rate ratio > 8% for 3m in region: us-west1. Trigger: http_5xx_ratio > threshold. PagerDuty incident created: PD-8271. Auto-escalation disabled due to maintenance window? (see link: https://app.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-8271)

sarah (oncall): Acked PD-8271. I'm on it. Any idea if this is a canary rollout or infra?

maria (runtime): seeing a strong cluster-level spike in 5xx from routing-service v2-canary. Sample logs showing increased connection resets to backend pool-rt-03.

maria (runtime): logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T01:45:10Z routing-service v2-canary: upstream returned 502 x3 for req id=abc123
2026-03-15T01:45:11Z routing-service v2-canary: downstream timeout after 3s for req id=def456
```

jordan (ops): adding context — autoscaler shows a sudden drop in healthy backends for pool-rt-03 (from 12 -> 6). Could be healthcheck churn. Scaling policy hasn't kicked due to probe failures.

sarah (oncall): OK. First priority: reduce customer impact. What's the request distribution? More from embeddings API? Which routes failing?

maria (runtime): most failing endpoints are /v1/generate and /v1/chat/stream. Error headers show upstream grpc-proxy 502. Affects ~15% of production requests in us-west1, latency for successful requests up ~30%.

sarah (oncall): Customers likely hit. I'm routing traffic away from v2-canary to stable. @jordan can you flip canary -> stable weight to 0? Provide command you will run.

jordan (ops): running rollout reweight now: `infractl traffic set routing-service --region us-west1 --version v2-canary --weight 0`

jordan (ops): done. Confirming traffic shifted. Monitoring metrics... error ratio dropping to 4.2% in the last 45s.

pagerduty: PD-8271 acknowledged by sarah (oncall). One pager escalation suppressed.

maria (runtime): good signal. I'm triggering a selective warmup of pool-rt-03 and re-running healthchecks: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/routing-service-pool-rt-03 -n prod`

maria (runtime): healthchecks recovered, backend count back to 11. Error ratio down to 2.1% now.

sarah (oncall): Nice. What about the canary itself — will it be reattempted? Any culprit in the canary image or config?

maria (runtime): preliminary: the canary had a config that increased max open connections to upstream without bumping timeout; combined with a broken upgrade of a sidecar that caused occasional connection resets. We'll pin canary and block re-rollouts until root cause is confirmed.

olivia (next-oncall): I'm taking the rotation in 30m. Anything I should watch for?

sarah (oncall): Handing over: system stabilized after traffic reweight + restart. Follow-ups: 1) postmortem to confirm root cause in canary sidecar upgrade, 2) confirm no cross-region ripple, 3) add guard to block canary traffic if pool healthy < 8. I'll create the incident doc.

jordan (ops): noted. I've added a temporary alert suppression for PD-8271 to avoid dupes while we do the postmortem ops work.

incident-bot: NOTE: customer-impact flag set: partial_degradation. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat/stream. Estimated affected qps: 200 -> degraded to 170 avg.

sarah (oncall): Posting the immediate timeline for the incident (for the doc):
- 01:42:10Z alert triggered (http_5xx_ratio > 8%)
- 01:43:05Z PD-8271 created and auto-paged
- 01:44:00Z sarah acknowledged; triage started
- 01:46:30Z traffic reweighted off v2-canary -> error ratio falling
- 01:48:10Z restart of pool-rt-03 recovery started
- 01:51:00Z backend count restored; errors < 3%

maria (runtime): adding runbook pointer: https://wiki.redwood.ai/ops/runbooks/routing-service-failures (steps followed: reweight -> restart -> healthcheck).

sarah (oncall): I'll mark PD-8271 resolved after we finish linking the notes. Olivia I'll hand over for watch until 02:30Z.

olivia (next-oncall): Got it. I'll watch dashboards and watch for any replays. If errors creep >4% again, I'll escalate to SRE lead.

jordan (ops): quick note: created a short-term flag to block canary traffic if pool healthy < 50% (PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/5321).

incident-bot: PD-8271 status: resolved by sarah (oncall). Resolution summary: reweighted traffic off problematic canary + restart of backend pool; customer impact partial_degradation ~8-12 min.

sarah (oncall): Thanks all. I'll draft a short postmortem and tag engineering/security if needed. Closing thread but will add notes to the incident doc. :thumbsup:
